title: Freeze contracts C1–C6 as Python modules + JSON Schema
outcome: C1 Envelope, C2 Record, C3 State, C4 Alert/Control, C5 RecoveryPlan, C6 Run dir frozen by 22 Nov as typed modules + JSON Schema, one canonical serializer, JSON-lines-over-Unix-socket transport; every ADR builds on these
acceptance: src/ks/contracts/ has one module + one JSON Schema per C1–C6 with the fields in CALL-01/maya.md §3 (C1 incl. nonce, expiry, epoch, full act chain; C2 incl. read_set, write_set before/after ver+hash, prev_hash, gw_sig; C2 values as hashes only)
pytest round-trip: for each contract, obj → canonical bytes → obj is identity, and the canonical bytes are stable across two runs (byte-equal) and validate against the schema
a single canonical serializer (sorted keys, fixed encoding) is the only one exported and is the one signer, gateway and verify must import
kabir signs off that the contracts satisfy all 11 day-one rules (CALL-01/kabir.md §4), checklist in the review note

log.msg: Kabir sign-off criterion is satisfied by SEC-03 (security review of C1-C6 vs 11 day-one rules); ADR-05 is the first ADR to start once C3/C5 are drafted
PMO: accepted — SEC-03 satisfies CON-01's security sign-off; faulty-run≡S* test stays in ADR-00
